title: [IELTS INSIGHTS] - Two plans for training sessions
prompt: The plans show the room layouts for training sessions for up to ten people and more than ten people. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The plans depict two different layouts that can be used to host training sessions, namely plan A for a maximum of ten participants and plan B for more than ten people.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, both plans feature the same key facilities, with the main differences being the number of seats, the location of the podium and the whiteboard.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the layouts in more detail, both plans share an identical entrance at the top-right corner. In plan A, a whiteboard runs along the front wall, with a podium positioned in the top-left corner. In comparison, plan B features a smaller podium centrally placed in the room, with a whiteboard directly behind it. Regarding refreshments, the morning tea area in plan A is positioned at the back of the room, whereas in plan B, an L-shaped one occupies the front-left corner.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In terms of seating arrangements, both plans provide three separate tables for trainees, arranged in a U-shaped formation. However, each table in plan A has three chairs, all facing inwards. In contrast, plan B accommodates more people with each table seating six participants - three on each side facing one another.
